title: Image of reachable codes under recoding
statement: Let $N$ be a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let $x$ be a binary input, and let $s$ be a natural number. For a code reachable from the initial configuration using transitions within window $s$, recode it as the configuration code at window size $s+1$ of a run witnessing that reachability; assign $0$ to codes that are not reachable. If the sets of reachable codes in windows $s$ and $s+1$ have equal cardinality, then the image of the window-$s$ reachable-code set under this recoding is exactly the window-$(s+1)$ reachable-code set.
